(pts note) | pādayām → G. pavarayām'; S1 S2 pādayām'. (pts note)

thi-ap8:8.4: tāvatiṁsamagacchahaṁ → tāvatiṁsaṁ agañchahaṁ (bj, sya-all) | tāvatiṁsamagacchahaṁ mahānelassa chādanaṁ → tāvatiṁsaṁ agacch ahaṁ mahānelassachadanaṁ (pts) | agañcha’haṁ → agacchahaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | agacch → S2 agañch'. (pts note)

thi-ap8:9.4: sattuppalassidaṁ → sattuppalānidaṁ (bj, pts) | sattupalān → S2 sattuppalā. (pts note)
thi-ap8:10.4: dharīyati sattatidevarājūnaṁ mahesittamakārayiṁ → dhariyyati sattatidevarājānaṁ mahesittam akārayiṁ (pts) | dhariyyati → G. dhariyati; S1 dharissati. (pts note)
thi-ap8:12.3: mamanuvattanti ādeyyavacanā ahuṁ → maṁ anuvattanti adeyyavacanā ahaṁ (pts) | anuvattanti → mamanuvattanti (bj: machasaṁ)
thi-ap8:12.4: ahuṁ → ahaṁ (sya-all) | adeyyavacanā → G. ādeyyavacanaṁ. (pts note)

thi-ap8:16.3: sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā → sabbāsavaparikkhīṇā (cck, sya-all) | parikkhīṇā → sabbāsavaparikkhīṇā (bj: machasaṁ) | parikkhīṇā → G. parikiṇṇā. (pts note)
